sources.snippet: Kanso Satori 1.0 GGUF GGUF release of Kanso Satori 1.0, ZenVoice's 4B on-device dictation cleanup model, for llama.cpp. Model Description Satori converts raw speech-to-text output into clean written text while preserving the speaker's wording and meaning. It is a single-purpose formatter, not a chat model. Punctuation and Capitalization: Restores punctuation, casing and sentence boundaries ...
